name: vibefoundry
description: Sets up and opens the VibeFoundry data-science IDE as a pane — installs everything it needs itself, then launches it in a terminal exactly as you would yourself.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and open the VibeFoundry IDE as a pane
interface.longDescription: Say "set me up to vibe code" and the plugin installs everything itself — Python, git, the data libraries, and the VibeFoundry IDE (the `vibefoundry` python package). Then "open VibeFoundry" launches it in a terminal on your current project and renders the IDE as a pane.
defaultPrompt: Set me up to vibe code.
